tools.name: list_my_orgs
tools.description: List the organizations this sign-in can reach. Use it first when no organization is known, when several may apply, or when asked what you can access. Returns orgs[] with slug (pass it as org to other tools), name, role, and a dashboard url.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List the organization's events, latest start date first (up to 200). Use it to find the eventId that every event-scoped tool needs. Returns events[] with eventId, number, name, status, type, start and end dates, timezone, city, isVirtual, and a dashboard url, plus truncated.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get one event's overview by eventId. Use it for the details and headline counts of a single event; use list_events to find events. Returns name, description, status, dates, timezone, venue, links, and stats counting speakers, sessions by status, sponsors, tracks, rooms, and submissions. Registration

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List the event's sessions (up to 200), optionally filtered by status, track, or scheduled/unscheduled. Use it to scan the program or find a sessionId; use get_session for one session in full and get_agenda for the timetable. Returns sessions[] with title, status, type, format, time, room, track, and

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Get one session in full by sessionId. Use it when you need a single session's description or speaker roster; use list_sessions to find the id. Returns title, status, type, format, time, room, track, description, speakers[] with role and confirmation, and a deep link url.

tools.name: get_agenda
tools.description: Get the event's draft timetable: scheduled sessions grouped by day and room in time order, plus a separate items list of breaks, plenums, and blockers. Use it to read or show the schedule; optionally limit to one day (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns days[] (rooms[] with sessions[]), items[] with kind and day,

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: List the event's forms (call for papers, registration, sponsor intake, portal, and custom) with status and submission counts by pipeline status. Use it to find a formId before list_submissions, set_submission_status, or update_form. Returns forms[] with formId, title, status, isActive, and submissio

tools.name: list_submissions
tools.description: List one form's submissions (up to 100, newest first), optionally filtered by status. Use it to review applicants or find submission ids for set_submission_status or decide_submission. Returns submissions[] with id, name, status, submitter, dates, a first answer preview, and payment, plus truncated.

tools.name: list_speaker_tasks
tools.description: List the event's speaker portal tasks (bio, photo, slides, travel, agreements, and custom tasks). Use it to see what speakers still owe before send_speaker_reminder or create_speaker_task. Returns tasks[] with id, title, type, status, dueDate, and the assigned contactId, plus total, truncated, and a

tools.description: Keyword search across the organization's contacts, sessions, submissions, events, sponsors, forms, and portals; pass eventId to keep one event. Use it for exact names, emails, or titles; use semantic_search when the wording may differ. Not metered. Returns up to 20 permission-filtered results[] with

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_my_orgs, list_events, get_session, list_submissions, search, check_schedule_conflicts, get_contact, list_associated_contacts, search_contacts, get_review_progress, get_registration_stats, get_ticketing_overview, list_attendees, get_email_activity, list_email_templates, draft_email, list_pending_approvals, send_speaker_reminder, check_in_attendee, request_media_upload · Private data: search, semantic_search, list_sponsors, get_contact, list_associated_contacts, search_contacts, draft_email, import_contacts, add_contact_note, send_speaker_message, remove_session_speaker, create_sponsor, update_contact, create_speaker_task, assign_speaker, invite_to_portal, send_email, request_media_upload, set_write_access · Public sink: get_contact, list_associated_contacts, search_contacts, list_attendees, get_email_activity, list_email_templates, draft_email, import_contacts, send_speaker_reminder, send_speaker_message, create_speaker_task, create_email_template, invite_to_portal, send_email, request_media_upload, set_write_access · Destructive: list_sessions, get_session, check_schedule_conflicts, update_session, delete_session, remove_session_speaker, delete_sponsor, schedule_session, update_form_pipeline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_my_orgs, list_events, get_session, list_submissions, search, check_schedule_conflicts, get_contact, list_associated_contacts, search_contacts, get_review_progress, get_registration_stats, get_ticketing_overview, list_attendees, get_email_activity, list_email_templates, draft_email, list_pending_approvals, send_speaker_reminder, check_in_attendee, request_media_upload · Private data: search, semantic_search, list_sponsors, get_contact, list_associated_contacts, search_contacts, draft_email, import_contacts, add_contact_note, send_speaker_message, remove_session_speaker, create_sponsor, update_contact, create_speaker_task, assign_speaker, invite_to_portal, send_email, request_media_upload, set_write_access · Public sink: get_contact, list_associated_contacts, search_contacts, list_attendees, get_email_activity, list_email_templates, draft_email, import_contacts, send_speaker_reminder, send_speaker_message, create_speaker_task, create_email_template, invite_to_portal, send_email, request_media_upload, set_write_access · Destructive: list_sessions, get_session, check_schedule_conflicts, update_session, delete_session, remove_session_speaker, delete_sponsor, schedule_session, update_form_pipeline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
